title: Fourier agreement count
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean function $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and a set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier agreement count is the number of inputs $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$ for which $f(x)$ equals the parity function associated with $S$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
